General information

This website describes services and professional background. It is not project-specific engineering advice, an inspection report, or a substitute for a professional evaluation.

Service scope and jurisdiction

Service availability depends on project type, location, scope, and applicable licensing and permitting requirements. Professional engineering and regulated services are provided only where the responsible professional and business hold the required authorizations. Third-party inspection acceptance and permit approval remain with the authority having jurisdiction.

Requests and agreements

Submitting a request does not confirm an appointment, authorize work, guarantee availability, or establish a professional services agreement. Scope, fees, deliverables, and terms must be agreed separately before services begin.

Professional background

The experience and previous government roles shown describe Ravinder Singh’s individual professional background, not the company’s operating history. They do not imply current government affiliation or endorsement. Academic and career information is presented from the professional profile supplied to the business.

External request form

Service requests are submitted through Google Forms, which opens in a new tab. Google’s own terms and privacy policies apply to its services. This website does not display or verify submission success on Google’s behalf.
